name: hypothetical-diff
description: Generalizes Hypothetical Document Embeddings (HyDE) from static documents to universal Before/After diffs across any non-coding or coding domain—writing, difficult conversations, negotiation, learning & mental models, habits, policy counterfactuals, strategy, calendars, contracts, spreadsheets, and code. Simulates anything at any granularity (L0 atomic micro-choices to L4 macro eras, turn-by-turn rallies, multi-horizon timelines, and Monte Carlo envelopes) in any user-set tone with interactive zoom and hunk mix-and-match.
suggestedPrompts: Simulate a 3-turn negotiation rally diff (spoken script + subtext + their pushback) in a warm, unshakeable tone
Run a Telescoping Diff (L3 1-year goal down to L0 Tuesday 7:15 AM micro-cue) and check for scale mismatches
Show me a Mental Model Diff (intuitive misconception vs. how it actually works) or Monte Carlo branching diff for this topic
